Name: VirusTotal - Livehunt Notifications Connector
Author: admin
Description: Pull information about Livehunt notifications and related files from VirusTotal. Note: this connector requires a premium API token. Dynamic list works with "rule_name" parameter.

Parameters.Description: Describes the name of the field where the environment name is stored. If the environment field isn't found, the environment is the default environment.

A regex pattern to run on the value found in the "Environment Field Name" field. Default is .* to catch all and return the value unchanged. Used to allow the user to manipulate the environment field via regex logic. If the regex pattern is null or empty, or the environment value is null, the final environment result is the default environment.
If enabled, verify the SSL certificate for the connection to the VirusTotal server is valid.

Specify a comma-separated list of engines that should be used, when counting the \'Engine Percentage Threshold To Fetch\' parameter. Example: AlienVault,Kaspersky. Note: if nothing is provided, all engines from the response are counted.
The percentage of engines that need to mark the file as suspicious/malicious before it's being ingested. Maximum value: 100. Minimum: 0.

Number of hours before the first connector iteration to retrieve notifications from. This parameter applies to the initial connector iteration after you enable the connector for the first time, or used as a fallback value in cases where connector's last run timestamp expires.
How many notifications to process per one connector iteration. Default: 40.

Parameters.DisplayName: Use dynamic list as a blacklist
Parameters.Description: If enabled, dynamic lists will be used as a blacklist.
The address of the proxy server to use.
The proxy username to authenticate with.
The proxy password to authenticate with.
